purpose: validate readouts before calibrating through them (R5)

parity_flat_features.tolerance_rule: max(0.05, 1/N) — never tighter than one readout unit
parity_flat_features.verdict_rule: PASS iff >=1 head shows arm-parity within max(0.05, 1/N) in every gated cell and recovers >=90% of features in every arm

parity_hierarchical_features.tolerance_rule: max(0.05, 1/N) — never tighter than one readout unit
parity_hierarchical_features.verdict_rule: PASS iff >=1 head shows arm-parity within max(0.05, 1/N) in every gated cell and recovers >=90% of features in every arm
